new.title: Chat SDK adds Instagram adapter
new.description: Chat SDK now supports Instagram Direct Messages. Build DM bots with media, quick replies, reactions, and story replies.

new.title: Vercel for Platforms can now deploy from your users' GitHub repositories
new.description: Pass a short-lived GitHub token when creating a deployment. Vercel uses it to retrieve the source, stores it encrypted, and never saves it on the deployment.

new.title: Cline is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
new.description: Cline is now available in the AI SDK harness layer through the @ai-sdk/harness-cline adapter, implemented in collaboration with the Cline team. Run it through the same HarnessAgent interface.

new.title: GLM 5.3 now available on AI Gateway
new.description: Call Z.ai's GLM-5.3 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no markup or platform fee, automatic fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.

new.title: Sign JWTs from your Functions without managing private keys
new.description: Vercel KMS lets you sign JWTs and messages from your Vercel Functions with managed keys. Authenticate with your function's OIDC token, keep private keys out of your code, and manage issuers, keys, and grants from the dashboard or CLI. Now in Public Beta.

new.title: Deploy Cursor Origin repositories with Vercel in public beta
new.description: Connect Cursor Origin repositories to Vercel projects for automatic Preview and Production deployments.

new.title: GPT-5.6 Sol is 50% off on AI Gateway for the next month
new.description: GPT-5.6 Sol is 50% off on Vercel AI Gateway from August 17 through September 18 on all requests running through AI Gateway.

removed.title: GLM 5.2 free for eve agents through August 27 via Blackbox on AI Gateway
removed.description: GLM 5.2, Z​.ai's open-weights coding model with a 1M-token context window, is free for eve agents through August 27, served by Blackbox AI on Vercel AI Gateway.

removed.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash now available on AI Gateway for 50% off
removed.description: Call Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, automatic fallbacks, spend tracking, and request traces.

removed.title: One-click upgrade for deprecated Node.js versions
removed.description: You can now upgrade Node.js 20 projects with one click from the Vercel Dashboard.

removed.title: Grok Build is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
removed.description: Grok Build is now available in the AI SDK harness layer through the @ai-sdk/harness-grok-build adapter, built on the ACP harness. Run it through the same HarnessAgent interface.

removed.title: Use ACP-compatible harnesses with the AI SDK harness layer
removed.description: The new @ai-sdk/harness-acp package is a meta adapter that lets you use any Agent Client Protocol compatible harness with the AI SDK's HarnessAgent.

removed.title: Exa joins the Vercel Agent Marketplace
removed.description: Exa's neural search engine delivers high-quality, relevant results to ground AI in fresh, current information. Add Exa to your Vercel app in minutes to power search, research agents, and context-aware features.

removed.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro now runs updated weights on AI Gateway
removed.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro now runs on updated weights by default on Vercel AI Gateway. Existing requests pick them up with no code change, and the dated model ID pins the new version.

unchanged.title: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) is now supported on Vercel CDN
unchanged.description: Vercel CDN now supports ECH for domains managed by Vercel DNS.
